proposal.title: Export tasks as a CSV file
proposal.description:
## Summary

Enable users to export their task lists to a CSV file from the Tasks page to facilitate data portability and reporting.

## Background

- Users have requested a way to export their tasks for backup or external reporting.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A "Export to CSV" button is present on the Tasks page.
- [ ] Clicking the button downloads a CSV file containing the current task list.
